bias.label: Leaning down below 3,903; Friday chop near lows

event: Gold market closes for the weekend tonight, around midnight SAST. No high-impact data before Monday's open.

bullets.title: Stuck below 3,903
bullets.text: Gold is about 3,886 at 19:40 SAST, up about 5 dollars on the day, after the post-PPI spike to the 3,920s faded (xauad/Swissquote, Kitco).

bullets.title: Wide day range
bullets.text: Today's range is about 3,866 to 3,924; Kitco's low at 16:54 SAST was 3,873, so the 3,866 low is UNVERIFIED (one source).

bullets.title: Big weekly loss
bullets.text: Trading Economics says gold is on track for a sharp weekly loss, still close to Thursday's 13-month low of 3,852.

bullets.title: Yields and dollar
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield is near 5.14% and the dollar index near 103.4, both firm and both a weight on gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: Futures price roughly 85-89% odds of a December quarter-point hike, and NY Fed's Williams said more hikes are likely (Trading Economics); exact odds UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Bowman unclear
bullets.text: We found no report yet on what Fed's Bowman said this evening, so her tone is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Weekend gap risk
bullets.text: Trump said the US no longer needs a deal with Iran and Brent is near 95.7 dollars, so weekend headlines can gap gold on Monday's open.
